summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser. Added rdflib/extras/shacl.py (parse_shacl_path and SHACLPathError) and test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py. The new tests and the existing test/test_path.py pass (42 passed) under the prepared venv. Nothing is committed, and no existing module changed. Lookups use Graph.value so None never acts as a wildcard, and None or string inputs raise SHACLPathError. mypy, ruff, and black are not installed in the venv, so the type-ignore placement and formatting were checked by reading only.
